cases.selection_note: Hidden-bust stress case: 21 hidden-bust region-days at Day 3-7 (selected by verification only; not representative)

run.mode: Historical replay research prototype - the frozen v3 quantile-gradient-boosting model executes live on stored real ECMWF IFS ENS forecast states; not a live or NCMRWF feed

model.calibration: isotonic regression of the estimated exceedance probability, fitted on validation only, frozen
model.exceedance_method: piecewise-linear CDF between the six predicted quantiles (q10..q95); beyond q95 (below q10) an exponential tail through the (q90, q95) [(q10, q25)] knots. An ESTIMATE from six predicted quantiles, not an exact CDF
model.crossing_correction: rearrangement (Chernozhukov, Fernandez-Val & Galichon 2010): each row's six predicted values are sorted, which never increases the quantile-estimation error; applied at prediction time only, crossing frequency measured and reported
model.alert_threshold_definition: calibrated bust probability giving a 10% false-alarm rate on VALIDATION
model.expected_error_definition: 'Expected error' = q50, the central (median) predicted normalized Z500 error, not a conditional mean
model.uncertainty_definition: central predicted error range = q25-q75; upper-tail error = q95 (not a maximum)

priority_formula.formula: score = p_bust * 0.5**((lead_day-1)/H) * evidence_weight + B * clip(upper_tail_error / bust_threshold - 1, 0, 1)
priority_formula.note: Product triage rule; weights are design choices, not fitted or validated constants.

attribution.method: model-level permutation importance (q90 estimator, validation); not a per-row attribution
attribution.note: Feature ranking is MODEL-LEVEL permutation importance of the q90 estimator (validation), the same for every row; values and percentiles are this row's inputs. Features are associated with the prediction; they are not causes.
